views.query: SELECT SYSUTCDATETIME() AS sample_time_utc, cacheobjtype, objtype, pool_id, COUNT_BIG(*) AS plan_count, SUM(CAST(size_in_bytes AS bigint)) AS size_in_bytes, SUM(CAST(usecounts AS bigint)) AS usecounts, SUM(CAST(refcounts AS bigint)) AS refcounts, SUM(CASE WHEN usecounts = 1 THEN CAST(1 AS bigint) ELSE 0 END) AS single_use_plan_count FROM sys.dm_exec_cached_plans GROUP BY cacheobjtype, objtype, pool_id

SELECT SYSUTCDATETIME() AS sample_time_utc, database_id, file_id, page_type, page_level, is_modified, numa_node, is_in_bpool_extension, COUNT_BIG(*) AS page_count, SUM(CAST(row_count AS bigint)) AS row_count, SUM(CAST(free_space_in_bytes AS bigint)) AS free_space_in_bytes, SUM(CAST(read_microsec AS bigint)) AS read_microsec FROM sys.dm_os_buffer_descriptors GROUP BY database_id, file_id, page_type, page_level, is_modified, numa_node, is_in_bpool_extension

SELECT SYSUTCDATETIME() AS sample_time_utc, name, type, pool_id, COUNT_BIG(*) AS entry_count, SUM(CAST(in_use_count AS bigint)) AS in_use_count, SUM(CASE WHEN is_dirty = 1 THEN CAST(1 AS bigint) ELSE 0 END) AS dirty_count, SUM(CAST(disk_ios_count AS bigint)) AS disk_ios_count, SUM(CAST(context_switches_count AS bigint)) AS context_switches_count, SUM(CAST(original_cost AS bigint)) AS original_cost, SUM(CAST(current_cost AS bigint)) AS current_cost, SUM(CAST(pages_kb AS bigint)) AS pages_kb, SUM(CAST(use_count AS bigint)) AS use_count FROM sys.dm_os_memory_cache_entries GROUP BY name, type, pool_id

SELECT SYSUTCDATETIME() AS sample_time_utc, type, memory_node_id, partition_type_desc, COUNT_BIG(*) AS object_count, SUM(CAST(pages_in_bytes AS bigint)) AS pages_in_bytes, SUM(CAST(bytes_used AS bigint)) AS bytes_used, MAX(max_pages_in_bytes) AS max_pages_in_bytes, SUM(CAST(waiting_tasks_count AS bigint)) AS waiting_tasks_count, SUM(CAST(exclusive_access_count AS bigint)) AS exclusive_access_count, MAX(CAST(contention_factor AS float)) AS max_contention_factor FROM sys.dm_os_memory_objects GROUP BY type, memory_node_id, partition_type_desc

SELECT SYSUTCDATETIME() AS sample_time_utc, ring_buffer_type, ring_buffer_group, COUNT_BIG(*) AS record_count, MIN([timestamp]) AS min_timestamp, MAX([timestamp]) AS max_timestamp, MIN(create_time) AS min_create_time, MAX(create_time) AS max_create_time FROM sys.dm_os_ring_buffers GROUP BY ring_buffer_type, ring_buffer_group
SELECT SYSUTCDATETIME() AS sample_time_utc, COUNT_BIG(*) AS frame_count, COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT stack_address) AS stack_count, MAX(frame_index) AS max_frame_index FROM sys.dm_os_stacks
